title: Nano Nuclear Energy Bring Microreactors to UAE
summary: US microreactor company Nano Nuclear Energy is on the path to deploy its technology to the Middle East after signing the first and only nuclear microreactor partnership with the UAE. Jay Yu, the company's founder, executive chairman and president spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the deployment in the UAE plus their plans for Mideast expansion.
